You need a monthly attribution report for your logistics business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Product analytics tracking plan for a SaaS client I used Google Analytics, SQL and defined 42 events and fixed 9 broken funnels.

On Churn cohort analysis for a SaaS client I used SQL, Looker and pinpointed a 30-day drop-off that drove 40% of churn.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
